The '''sublight survey droid''' was a [[Survey droid/Legends|survey droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One of these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] several [[Standard century/Legends|hundred]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]; a report was logged but the planet was forgotten.<ref name="BGS" />
